subject.title: Bug: 升级后 Dashboard 历史会话索引/映射错乱

question: Should OpenClaw attempt automatic repair of wrong Dashboard key to transcript mappings when the original transcript is preserved but `sessions.json` points at a different sessionId?
rationale: Current code can canonicalize orphaned key names, but choosing a different preserved transcript for an existing Dashboard key can expose or attach the wrong conversation unless maintainers define the proof policy.

options.title: Manual/doctor repair only
options.body: Keep this issue open for a doctor-style diagnostic and require explicit evidence before rewriting any stored Dashboard mapping.

options.title: Automatic relink with strict metadata
options.body: Allow startup or doctor to relink only when durable transcript metadata uniquely identifies the logical session key.

options.title: Defer to transcript-header work
options.body: Wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/84209 to land first, then revisit whether enough identity exists for safe repair.

recommendation.title: Manual/doctor repair only
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a doctor-style diagnostic and require explicit evidence before rewriting any stored Dashboard mapping.

likelyOwner.reason: The available blame points to recent ownership of the session-history and migration code paths, and the decision spans persisted session-state policy.
